description: A single series of rounded vertical bars showing desktop visitors over six months.
overview: The baseline bar chart inside a `Card`: one rounded bar per month, a month axis, a dashed horizontal grid and a tooltip without a label. Start here and add series, stacking or labels as needed.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and change each `dataKey` to match your fields. Set the bar color with `fill` and the series label in `chartConfig`. The component takes no props.
